improve_your_matches.guidance: Clarifying the following questions will help narrow down the best match and adjust artist rankings.

refinement_questions.question: Will the venue provide direct sound amplification/PA connection for the headline set, or must the artist bring a full sound system?
refinement_questions.expected_impact: Clarifies equipment scope. If self-amplification is required for the 80-guest room, artists with portable acoustic PA gear will rank higher.

refinement_questions.question: Are there specific genre or language preferences for the 45-minute set (e.g. Hindi acoustic vs English/indie)?
refinement_questions.expected_impact: Refines repertoire matching against artists with demonstrated Hindi vs Western live performance records.
